hypotheses.T0_full_context_is_a_compact_controller: A linear top-64 full-residual code predicts at least 50 percent of held-out Layer-0 margin-operator variation in every seed.
hypotheses.T1_attention_context_is_needed: At Layer 0, full-residual top-64 held-out R2 exceeds final-token top-64 R2 by at least 0.10 in every seed.
hypotheses.T2_low_degree_tensor_map_improves_contro: At Layer 0, adding quadratic top-16 full-state features improves over linear top-16 by at least 0.10 in every seed.
hypotheses.T3_local_bilinear_state_is_predictive: Layer-0 activation top-64 predicts at least 30 percent of held-out operator variation in every seed.
hypotheses.T4_controller_transfers_across_pairs: For full-residual top-64, held-out R2 is no more than 0.20 below validation R2 in every seed.
